Scene:
他难怪抱怨，他想他的朋友，因为他不要离开他的城市。他的妈妈找到孟子一个老师。跟老师孟子学最重要的文学，所以他成为哲学家。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 他的妈妈找到孟子一个老师：给孟子找到……

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 找到孟子一个老师：给孟子找到了一个老师，use 给 before the beneficiary and make the teacher the object of 找到; 了 marks the completed action.
Run 2: 找到孟子一个老师：给孟子找了一个老师，Use 给 to mark Mengzi as the beneficiary of the action; the completed action also needs 了.

output.reason: Both runs identify the missing beneficiary marker 给 and correct the phrase to the teacher-accepted structure 给孟子找了/找到了一个老师.
